test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

yzx_y_xxyz_x_zxx
solution:
Given series: yzx_y_xxyz_x_zxx

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) yzxx → yzx__y__y__z__xxyz__x__x__x__zxx → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) yyzx → yzx__y__y__y__xxyz__z__x__x__zxx → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) xxyz → yzx__x__y__x__xxyz__y__x__z__zxx → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) xzxy → yzx__**x**__y__**z**__xxyz__**x**__x__**y**__zxx → (It follows the pattern of yzxx - yzxx - yzxx - yzxx)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
